title: erysimum flavum var. subviride
intro: Erysimum flavum var. subviride, commonly known as White Wallflower or White Erysimum, is a flowering plant species within the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, antimicrobial properties, and antioxidant activities that may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of White Wallflower are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-anxiety and anti-depressive effects, and potentially help with wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm the extent of these effects.
